description.p: In an era of AI software authoring, all that's left is taste. Taste is a GTK4/libadwaita IDE built around one idea: the agent works beside your files, in the project's own devcontainer, and the IDE is what you use to direct it.

Every environment is an issue in progress: the backlog is a ref in your repository, starting an issue clones it into an environment of its own with an agent and a container, and the coordinator — the chat in your own environment — keeps the backlog in order, starts work on what is pressing and reviews what comes back. Nothing an agent runs reaches your home, your keys or your credentials, and nothing pushes to your remote without you.
Rootless Podman devcontainers, git in the file tree, one search box that every pane answers, voice input transcribed locally, and an Agent Client Protocol client as the way agents plug in.
